article_manifest.summary: La Chine ne se contente plus d'investir en Afrique : elle y déploie aussi sa puissance militaire. article_manifest.summary: According to a source on site, a guard opened fire on his colleagues on Sunday, November 1, 2026 around 8 p.m., at the pumping station near the Gao gardens, before disappearing . The suspect, identified as Youssouf Ibrahim, is said to be a former combatant who laid down his arms and integrated under the Disarmament, Demobilization, Reintegration and Integration (DDRI) programme.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: more than 86,000 reservists registered out of the 100,000 expected by the end of 2026
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso : plus de 86 000 réservistes inscrits sur les 100 000 attendus d’ici fin 2026
article_manifest.summary: One month after the opening of registrations, the Burkinabe military reserve is already attracting a significant number of registrants. During the celebration of the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces, Sunday, November 1, 2026 in Ouagadougou, Major General Célestin Simporé, Minister of State for War and Patriotic Defence, welcomed the support of the populations, with more than 86,000 people already registered The authorities are aiming to form 100,000 reservists by the end of 2026.

article_manifest.title: Mali: A 2-year-old child killed by a...
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Un enfant de 2 ans tué par un...
article_manifest.summary: The alleged perpetrator, a man named Marcel suffering from severe mental disorders, rushed at the toddler before violently throwing him to the ground and against a wooden stool. The child succumbed instantly. Questioned on the spot by a gendarme who was passing with the help of local residents, the suspect was taken into custody at the gendarmerie brigade While the family calls for calm, this drama arouses a strong indignation among the population as well as of course social networks.

article_manifest.title: Niger : après quatre Su-30 en août, Alger déploie des unités militaires au sol
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : après quatre Su-30 en août, Alger déploie des unités militaires au sol
article_manifest.summary: Des militaires algériens ont rejoint le nord du Niger durant le week-end du 31 octobre 2026, d’après la presse nigérienne. Leur arrivée fait suite à l’envoi de quatre Su-30 à Niamey deux mois plus tôt, et marque le passage d’un appui aérien à une présence terrestre. Des chasseurs d’août au feu vert du Parlement Le 30 août 2026, au lendemain de la mutinerie de Niamey, l’Algérie avait posé ses chasseurs sur la base aérienne 101, à la demande de Niamey, selon le ministère algérien de la Défense.

article_manifest.title: 6 Niger: Les dessous du voyage stratégique du Premier ministre Ali Mahaman Lamine Zeine à Benghazi
article_manifest.original_title: 6 Niger: Les dessous du voyage stratégique du Premier ministre Ali Mahaman Lamine Zeine à Benghazi
article_manifest.summary: Le Premier ministre nigérien, Ali Mahaman Lamine Zeine en mode supersonique s'est rendu le 1er novembre 2026 à Benghazi, dans l'est de la Libye, à la tête d'une délégation comprenant le chef d'état-major général des armées, le général de corps d'armée Maman Sani Kiaou, ainsi que plusieurs chefs de corps. Il ne s'agit pas d'une simple visite de courtoisie diplomatique.

article_manifest.title: First convoy of Algerian troops and tankers reaches northern Niger
article_manifest.original_title: First convoy of Algerian troops and tankers reaches northern Niger
article_manifest.summary: A first convoy of Algerian soldiers was seen in northern Niger this weekend, a week after Algerian lawmakers approved the deployment of troops to the neighbouring country, according to French radio station RFI. The media reported that about sixty Algerian tankers transporting fuel and secured by Algerian soldiers crossed the border with Niger, where they were welcomed by members of the Niger Armed Forces.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa neutralize several terrorists in the areas of Niono and Saré-Nguéou
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa neutralisent plusieurs terroristes dans les zones de Niono et Saré-Nguéou
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing the permanent operations of surveillance, control and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. On Thursday, October 29, 2026, a reconnaissance mission in and around the Niono area located a group of terrorists .

article_manifest.title: Menaka region: 54 corpses discovered at the camp in Tagadayat
article_manifest.original_title: Région de Menaka : 54 cadavres découverts au campement à Tagadayat
article_manifest.summary: A joint FAMa-Partners patrol led to the discovery, about 35 kilometers southeast of the city of Menaka, of 54 lifeless bodies in a camp in Tagadayat. The first testimonies hold as perpetrators of these killings the Islamic State in the Great Sahara (EIGS). The information was disclosed on 24 October by the General Staff of the Armed Forces .

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: new FAMa strikes in the Niono area
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : nouvelles frappes des FAMa dans la zone de Niono
article_manifest.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, continue their operations to secure the territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. The General Staff of the Armed Forces gave an update on two actions carried out at the end of last week . On Thursday, October 29, 2026, a reconnaissance mission spotted a group of terrorists in the Niono area.

article_manifest.title: Journalists: November 2 between memory and waiting for justice
article_manifest.original_title: Journalistes : le 2 novembre entre mémoire et attente de justice
article_manifest.summary: This MOMENT On November 2, 2013, Ghislaine Dupont and Claude Verlon were kidnapped in Kidal after an interview carried out as part of a report. The bodies of the two Radio France Internationale journalists were found a few hours later outside the city In December 2013, the UN General Assembly proclaimed 2 November as the International Day to End Impunity for Crimes against Journalists.

article_manifest.title: Libya: Benghazi and Niamey show their willingness to strengthen their security cooperation
article_manifest.original_title: Libye: Benghazi et Niamey affichent leur volonté de renforcer leur coopération sécuritaire
article_manifest.summary: The rapprochement between the authorities of eastern Libya and the Nigerien power takes on a new dimension with the announced signing of a strategic cooperation protocol, against the backdrop of a recomposition of security balances in the Sahel and North Africa .

article_manifest.title: Fire in the rural commune of Dirkou: nearly a thousand people affected (DGPC)
article_manifest.original_title: Incendie dans la commune rurale de Dirkou : près de mille personnes affectées (DGPC)
article_manifest.summary: Niamey, 02 Nov (ANP)- On October 24, 2026, a violent fire broke out in the palm grove of the rural commune of Dirkou in the village of Argui affecting nearly a thousand people and destroying several hectares of date and vegetable crops, announced the Directorate General of Civil Protection (DGPC) In this painful circumstance, on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, the prefect of the department of Bilma, Captain Lamine Hamet, went to Eyni, in the village of Argui, to see the damage caused by the fire that occurred on Saturday, October 24.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Assassinats de Ghislaine Dupont et Claude Verlon en 2013 - «On attend une nouvelle déclassification depuis 3 ans» (RFI)
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Assassinats de Ghislaine Dupont et Claude Verlon en 2013 - «On attend une nouvelle déclassification depuis 3 ans» (RFI)
article_manifest.summary: Le 2 novembre, c'est la Journée internationale de la fin de l'impunité pour les crimes commis contre les journalistes, initiée en 2013 suite à l'assassinat dans le nord du Mali de la reporter Ghislaine Dupont et du technicien de reportage Claude Verlon, tous deux de RFI. C'était il y a 13 ans jour pour jour et leurs proches continuent de faire vivre leur mémoire mais aussi de réclamer la levée des obstacles administratifs dans leur quête de vérité.

article_manifest.title: الجيش الجزائري يؤمّن قافلة وقود إلى أغاديز في النيجر
article_manifest.original_title: الجيش الجزائري يؤمّن قافلة وقود إلى أغاديز في النيجر
article_manifest.summary: أشاد وزير البترول النيجري حمادو تيني بجودة العلاقات الثنائية، مؤكداً أن شحنة الوقود ستخفف أزمة الوقود في النيجر، مشيراً إلى أهمية التعاون المستمر لمواجهة التحديات العالمية في سلاسل الإمداد. - أكد سفير الجزائر في نيامي أن الشحنة جاءت استجابة عاجلة لتخفيف نقص الوقود في النيجر، حيث تم تفريغها في مستودع أغاديز لتلبية الطلب المتزايد في المنطقة.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: "The use of the Laabal card has been diverted from its original purpose", denounces the Minister of Security
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso : « L’utilisation de la carte Laabal a été détournée de sa vocation initiale », dénonce le ministre de la sécurité
article_manifest.summary: On the occasion of the monthly ceremony of the rise of national colors, this Monday, November 2, 2026 in Ouagadougou, the Minister of Security, Mahamadou Sana, welcomed the commitment of the security forces in the protection of the populations . However, he denounced certain practices contrary to the values of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP), including the misuse of the Laabal card for racketeering and corruption.

article_manifest.original_title: Insécurité à Bamako : La police élucide trois affaires de meurtres et d’assassinats en un temps record
article_manifest.summary: Thanks to the responsiveness of law enforcement and the rapid exploitation of clues, the alleged perpetrators of these crimes were all arrested within 24 to 48 hours, illustrating the determination of the authorities to hunt down crime in all its forms. The first case concerns the murder of Broulaye Doumbia, a 23-year-old hair salon promoter residing in Sébénikoro .

article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : Deux positions terroristes frappées à Koulikoro et à Mopti
article_manifest.summary: On 24 and 25 October 2026, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) carried out strikes against three points of regroupment of terrorist elements in the Koulikoro and Mopti regions.
